name: zero-overhead
description: The freelance back office you own. Hours, invoices, spending and quarterly taxes, running in your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:ci: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, like `https://yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com`. See [setup step 1](https://github.com/erikbettencourt/zero-overhead/blob/main/docs/setup.md#1-set-up-cloudflare-access-the-login).

POLICY_AUD.description: The Application Audience (AUD) Tag of the Access application you made for this app.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Your email address: the only one allowed in. Separate several with commas.

DB.description: Your data: clients, hours, invoices, transactions and settings.
